components.name: Primary Docket Action
components.description: The consequential paper-surface action, used sparingly for the strongest available route.
components.css: .ds-docket-action { position: relative; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: .85rem 3.25rem .75rem 1.35rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-docket-action::before { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 1.1rem; top: 50%; width: 1.15rem; height: 1px; background: currentColor; } .ds-docket-action::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 1.1rem; top: 50%; width: .42rem; height: .42rem; border-top: 1px solid currentColor; border-right: 1px solid currentColor; transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(45deg); } .ds-docket-action:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-docket-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #79e6eb); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--ink-blueprint, #0b1c2d); } .ds-docket-action--primary { border-color: var(--vermilion, #df4a39); background: var(--vermilion, #df4a39); color: #07131f; } .ds-docket-action--primary:hover { border-color: var(--ink-blueprint, #0b1c2d); background: var(--ink-blueprint, #0b1c2d); color: var(--paper, #f1eadb); }

components.name: Secondary Docket Action

components.name: Blueprint Navigation Link
components.description: A condensed uppercase route drawn directly onto the blueprint header field.
components.css: .ds-blueprint-nav { padding: .75rem 1.25rem; background: var(--ink-blueprint, #0b1c2d); color: var(--paper, #f1eadb); } .ds-blueprint-nav__link { position: relative; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 .25rem; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; color: inherit; font-family: var(--display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .13em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-blueprint-nav__link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: .25rem; height: 1px; background: var(--verified, #44c0c9); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-blueprint-nav__link:hover::after, .ds-blueprint-nav__link:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-blueprint-nav__link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #79e6eb); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--ink-blueprint, #0b1c2d); }

components.name: Blueprint Index Toggle
components.description: The square mobile index control with ruled open and close states.
components.css: .ds-index-toggle { min-width: 4.75rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: .45rem .6rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .65rem; border: 1px solid rgb(121 230 235 / 62%); border-radius: 0; background: var(--ink-blueprint, #0b1c2d); color: var(--paper, #f1eadb); font-family: var(--display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-index-toggle__mark { width: 1.05rem; display: grid; gap: .32rem; } .ds-index-toggle__mark i { width: 100%; height: 1px; display: block; background: currentColor; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-index-toggle:hover { border-color: rgb(121 230 235 / 62%); } .ds-index-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #79e6eb); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--ink-blueprint, #0b1c2d); } .ds-index-toggle[aria-expanded='true'] .ds-index-toggle__mark i:first-child { transform: translateY(.17rem) rotate(45deg); } .ds-index-toggle[aria-expanded='true'] .ds-index-toggle__mark i:last-child { transform: translateY(-.17rem) rotate(-45deg); }

components.name: Active Section Index
components.description: A punched paper index route with a vermilion active edge.
components.html: 01Automation
components.css: .ds-section-index { width: 7rem; min-height: 15rem; border-left: 1px solid rgb(21 37 56 / 24%); background: var(--paper, #f1eadb); color: var(--ink, #152538); box-shadow: -.5rem 0 1rem rgb(21 37 56 / 10%); } .ds-section-index__item { position: relative; height: 100%; min-height: 15rem; padding: 1.4rem .75rem 1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; writing-mode: vertical-rl; } .ds-section-index__item::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: .85rem; left: .45rem; width: .7rem; height: .7rem; border: 1px solid rgb(21 37 56 / 55%); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink-blueprint, #0b1c2d); box-shadow: inset 0 .15rem .25rem rgb(0 0 0 / 35%); } .ds-section-index__item::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-block: 0; left: 0; width: 3px; background: var(--vermilion, #df4a39); transform: scaleY(1); transform-origin: top; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-section-index__number, .ds-section-index__label { font-family: var(--display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-section-index__number { color: var(--vermilion, #df4a39); font-size: 1.3rem; } .ds-section-index__label { font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: .035em; } .ds-section-index__item:hover::after, .ds-section-index__item:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleY(1); } .ds-section-index__item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #79e6eb); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--ink-blueprint, #0b1c2d); }

components.name: Ready Destination
components.description: An enabled contact register cell that inverts from paper to blueprint.
components.css: .ds-destination { min-width: 0; min-height: 7.5rem; padding: 1.4rem 1.75rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; border-right: 1px solid rgb(21 37 56 / 22%); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(21 37 56 / 22%); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper, #f1eadb); color: var(--ink, #152538); text-decoration: none; } .ds-destination > span { font-family: var(--display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-destination small { margin-top: .8rem; color: #7d4630; font-family: var(--body, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); font-size: .86rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-destination:hover, .ds-destination:focus-visible { background: var(--ink-blueprint, #0b1c2d); color: var(--paper, #f1eadb); } .ds-destination:hover small, .ds-destination:focus-visible small { color: var(--verified, #44c0c9); } .ds-destination:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #79e6eb); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--ink-blueprint, #0b1c2d); }

components.css: .ds-evidence-row { min-height: 8.25rem; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(7rem,11rem) minmax(10rem,15rem) minmax(0,1fr); align-items: stretch; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(121 230 235 / 28%); background: var(--ink-blueprint, #0b1c2d); color: var(--paper, #f1eadb); } .ds-evidence-row__index, .ds-evidence-row__label, .ds-evidence-row__proof { min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; display: flex; align-items: center; border-right: 1px solid rgb(121 230 235 / 22%); } .ds-evidence-row__index { justify-content: space-between; gap: .8rem; color: var(--verified, #44c0c9); font-family: var(--display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-evidence-row__index svg { width: 2.65rem; height: 2.65rem; padding: .35rem; border: 1px solid rgb(121 230 235 / 46%); border-radius: 50%; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.35; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; } .ds-evidence-row__label { color: var(--verified, #44c0c9); font-family: var(--display, 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif); font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .075em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-evidence-row__proof { max-width: 76ch; border-right: 0; font-family: var(--body, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.5; } @media (max-width: 56.25rem) { .ds-evidence-row { grid-template-columns: 5.25rem minmax(0,1fr); } .ds-evidence-row__index { grid-row: 1 / span 2; padding: 1rem .75rem; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; } .ds-evidence-row__label { padding: 1rem 1.25rem .25rem; border-right: 0; } .ds-evidence-row__proof { padding: .3rem 1.25rem 1.35rem; } }

narrative.overview:
Change-Control Folio treats the interface as a working record: warm paper sheets, navy blueprint fields, carbon-copy annotations, routed diagrams, and inspection marks. The system feels technical, accountable, and handled by people—not theatrical, glossy, or terminal-themed.

Evidence Docket is the composition grammar inside that world. Information is organized as ruled registers, numbered rows, edge indexes, annotations, and flat overlapping sheets; the visitor should be able to trace each visual claim through a clear sequence.

Density is deliberate but never cramped. Condensed display type carries labels and headings while a hyperlegible sans serif handles proof, with cyan reserved for verified routes and vermilion reserved for consequential outcomes.
keyCharacteristics: Sharp, square folio sheets with one-pixel ruled construction.
Warm paper alternating with blueprint navy ledgers.
Condensed industrial hierarchy paired with hyperlegible body copy.
Cyan verification routes, vermilion outcome marks, and copper annotation traces.
Flat overlap and paper grain instead of generic digital-card elevation.
Responsive reflow that preserves evidence order and physical-document cues.

rules.name: The Evidence Ink Rule
rules.body: Cyan means verified route, active evidence, or system connection; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Vermilion Rarity Rule
rules.body: Reserve vermilion for consequential actions, outcomes, and state changes so every mark retains authority.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Condensed type names the record; hyperlegible type explains the evidence. Do not use the display face for paragraphs or the body face for oversized spectacle.

rules.name: The Evidence Order Rule
rules.body: Responsive reflow may change orientation and column count, but it never changes the logical sequence of index, label, evidence, and outcome.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Use rules, tonal changes, and sheet overlap first; add a shadow only when it explains a physical layer or an interaction state.

rules.name: The Ruled Edge Rule
rules.body: If a shape does not communicate paper construction, routing, registration, or status, keep it square and let the grid carry the form.

rules.name: The Bounded Motion Rule
rules.body: Motion confirms a route, stamp, menu, or visibility change once; it never loops, blocks reading, or carries required meaning.

rules.name: The Blueprint Focus Rule
rules.body: Every interactive element receives the same high-contrast cyan outline and navy halo, including paper-surface controls.

dos: Do alternate warm paper and blueprint ledgers to establish section authority.
Do use one-pixel rules, numbered indexes, leaders, and registration marks to make relationships explicit.
Do preserve Problem → Intervention → Outcome and equivalent evidence sequences at every breakpoint.
Do reserve cyan for verified routes and vermilion for consequential outcomes or actions.
Do keep body copy in the hyperlegible face and display copy short, condensed, and operational.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion` by presenting every component in its final readable state.
donts: Don't introduce generic rounded cards, pill chips, glass panels, gradient glows, or hacker-terminal spectacle.
Don't use paper texture or blueprint grid as a substitute for semantic grouping and real rules.
Don't scatter vermilion or cyan as decorative color; each accent must communicate a system role.
Don't add floating elevation to ordinary containers or round the square folio controls.
Don't animate continuously, reorder evidence for visual novelty, or hide required information behind motion.
Don't fabricate enabled states for unavailable destinations; placeholders remain explicit and inert.
